title: Recipient absent or parcel undelivered (customer side)
keywords: recipient absent not home undelivered redelivery return fee perishable left at door 3 days
body: If the second attempt also fails, the parcel is returned to the sender. Return fee: the higher of $7 or 50% of the category price, plus any area surcharge.
Perishables are not re-delivered; they're left at the door with photo proof.
Agents must not leave parcels at the door without the recipient's consent (except perishables per SOP).
escalate: SOP says a return fee needs the merchant's prior approval, and TikTok allows 2 working days. Confirm which applies.
